questions.question: Which HTML element is used for the largest standard heading?
questions.explanation: <h1> represents the highest-level heading. <head> contains document metadata, not visible page headings.

questions.question: Which CSS property changes the text colour of an element?
questions.explanation: The color property sets the foreground text colour. background-color changes the element's background.

questions.question: What does CSS Flexbox primarily help you do?
questions.explanation: Flexbox is a CSS layout model for arranging and distributing space among items in a container.

questions.question: Which JavaScript keyword declares a block-scoped variable that can be reassigned?
questions.explanation: let declares a block-scoped variable that can be reassigned. const is also block-scoped but cannot be reassigned.

questions.question: Which JavaScript method selects the first element matching a CSS selector?
questions.explanation: document.querySelector() returns the first element that matches the supplied CSS selector.

digital-marketing.title: Digital Marketing
digital-marketing.description: Content, audiences and online campaign fundamentals

questions.question: What is the main purpose of identifying a target audience?
options: To reach people most likely to need the offer
To make every post go viral
To use the same message for everyone
questions.explanation: A target audience is the group most likely to be interested in a product, service or message. Understanding it helps shape relevant communication.

questions.question: What does a call to action (CTA) encourage an audience to do?
questions.explanation: A CTA prompts a specific action, such as signing up, learning more or making a purchase.

questions.question: Which metric measures the percentage of people who clicked a link after seeing it?
questions.explanation: Click-through rate (CTR) is the proportion of impressions that resulted in clicks.

questions.question: Why should a business keep its brand message consistent across platforms?
options: To make every platform identical in format
To help audiences recognise and understand the brand
questions.explanation: Consistent messaging strengthens recognition and makes the brand's value and personality clearer across channels.

questions.question: What is content marketing mainly intended to do?
options: Provide useful or relevant content to attract and engage an audience
Publish unrelated posts as often as possible
questions.explanation: Content marketing uses relevant, useful content to attract and engage a defined audience and support business goals over time.

ui-ux-design.title: UI/UX Design
ui-ux-design.description: User interfaces, usability and design thinking

questions.question: What does UI stand for in digital product design?
questions.explanation: UI means User Interface: the visual and interactive parts of a digital product that people use.

questions.question: What is a primary goal of UX design?
options: Make the product difficult to navigate
Use as many colours as possible
questions.explanation: UX design focuses on making a product useful, usable and satisfying for the people using it.

questions.question: What is a wireframe commonly used for?
options: Planning a page's structure before detailed visual design
questions.explanation: A wireframe is a simplified representation of a screen's structure and content layout.

questions.question: Which practice helps check whether users can complete tasks successfully?
questions.explanation: Usability testing observes people attempting tasks and helps identify problems in the design.

questions.question: What does accessibility in interface design aim to achieve?
options: Make products usable by people with a range of abilities
Use smaller text on every screen
questions.explanation: Accessible design considers different abilities and ways of interacting so more people can use the product.

questions.question: What is phishing?
options: A method of backing up files
A deceptive attempt to obtain sensitive information
A way to improve internet speed
questions.explanation: Phishing uses deceptive messages or websites to trick people into revealing information or taking unsafe actions.

questions.question: Which password is generally the strongest?
options: A long, unique passphrase with varied characters
questions.explanation: Long, unique passwords or passphrases are harder to guess. Reusing passwords increases risk if one account is compromised.

questions.question: Why is multi-factor authentication useful?
options: It adds another verification step beyond a password
It removes the need for passwords everywhere
It makes devices immune to malware
It shares login details with trusted contacts
questions.explanation: Multi-factor authentication requires an additional factor, making account access harder with only a stolen password.

questions.question: What should you do if an unexpected email asks you to urgently confirm your bank password through a link?
options: Avoid the link and verify through the bank's official channel
questions.explanation: Urgency and requests for passwords are warning signs. Verify independently using a known official channel.

questions.question: What is the purpose of installing security updates?
options: To fix known vulnerabilities and improve software security
To make all online activity anonymous
To guarantee that no attack can happen
To remove the need for backups
questions.explanation: Security updates often patch vulnerabilities that attackers could otherwise exploit.

questions.question: What is the median of the numbers 2, 4, 7, 9 and 12?
questions.explanation: The values are already in order. With five values, the middle (third) value is 7.

questions.question: Which chart is commonly useful for comparing values across categories?
questions.explanation: A bar chart makes it easy to compare quantities across distinct categories.

questions.question: A dataset contains 20 records, and 5 are marked complete. What percentage are complete?
questions.explanation: 5 out of 20 is 5 ÷ 20 = 0.25, which is 25%.

questions.question: Why is data cleaning performed before analysis?
options: To identify and correct errors or inconsistencies
questions.explanation: Data cleaning addresses issues such as duplicates, inconsistent formats and missing or inaccurate values so analysis is more reliable.

questions.question: In a spreadsheet, what does the formula =SUM(A1:A5) do?
options: Adds the values from A1 through A5
questions.explanation: SUM adds the numeric values in the specified range, including A1 and A5.
